description.value:
Swarm adrenal glands allow for tiring bursts of speed.

Activate—Adrenal Boost r

Frequency three times per day

Requirements You're not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued]

Trigger Your turn begins

Effect You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened] until the end of the turn and can use the extra action only to Strike or Stride. When this effect ends, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1} and fatigued until you rest for at least 10 minutes.

You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2} the second time a day you Adrenal Boost, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 3} the third time a day.
